Maria G: Heads up — tree down across College Ave near Shattuck, just took out the overhead wires. AC Transit detours 51/57, BART ok but slow at Rockridge. Photo: https://imgur.com/abcd123
Sam: ugh — stuck on the detour, buses routing via College -> Ashby. anyone in the Rockridge area driving into SF?
Raj: I can swing by with 1 seat — leaving in 10. ping me @Maria G
Liz: LOL my pup thinks the tree is a new chew toy. can someone grab me if needed? :dog:
Jordan: Taking the ferry from Jack London — ETA +20 but at least dry. heads up for people with bikes.
ac-transit-bot: Route 51: detour via College Ave. Expect 15-25 min delays. https://ac-transit.org/alerts/1987
Maria G: thanks Raj! can you pick up @Liz? meet at College & Mandana in 8?
Sam: also FYI Lane 2 is blocked, MUNI realtime map shows 51 paused near Dunsmuir.
Liz: sold — will bring coffee as payment :coffee: anyone want a donut?
Jordan: I'll take a donut. :raised_hands:
Maria G: ok coordinating — if you need a ride DM Raj, else team carpools in parking lot A at 8:30. stay safe y'all.
Sam: solid, thx. :thumbsup: 
Raj: leaving now, will post when I reach Mandana.
Maria G: update: wires cleared by PG&E crew, buses resuming but expect backlog for next hour.
Raj: on my way, no room for bike tho.
Liz: thanks!!
